{{Quote|I&hellip;will&hellip;''break you!!!|[[Xecr Nist]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|audio=XecrNist-IWIllBreakYou.flac|<ref name="EEaudio">[[Empire's End (audio drama)|''Empire's End'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The '''Mission to Vjun''' was carried out in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and three fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in order to rescue three [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] [[Chief/Legends|chieftains]] captured by the [[Dark Empire]]. Luke used Force lightning to ensure the victory of the Jedi.<ref name="EE1" />
